macros.name: listingfont
macros.doc: The font used in the listing is controlled by the macro \listingfont.

macros.name: listingindent
macros.doc: The indentation of the left margin of the typeset code is determined by \listingindent.

macros.name: listingpenalty
macros.doc: The penalty for page breaks inside a listing is given by \listingpenalty.

macros.name: NewFileListingCommand
macros.doc: New filelisting-like commands can be defined using the \NewFileListingCommand macro.

macros.name: NewListingEnvironment
macros.doc: New listing-like environments can be defined using the \NewListingEnvironment macro.

macros.name: postlistingpenalty
macros.doc: The penalty for page breaks just before or after a listing is given by \prelistingpenalty (default value 100) and \postlistingpenalty (default value -50), respectively.

macros.name: prelistingpenalty
macros.doc: The penalty for page breaks just before or after a listing is given by \prelistingpenalty (default value 100) and \postlistingpenalty (default value -50), respectively.

envs.name: listing
envs.doc: The listing environment allows to include source code of computer programs in LaTeX documents by including the code between \begin{listing} and \end{listing}.
